label: In the fixed three-world interpretation every causal graph is well-founded and…, by Direct-proof
meaning: A fresh fixed Fin3 interpretation lies inside the acyclic-world setting: each raw cause relation is well-founded with existing distinct endpoints, and the actual-source value images are {true},{false},{false}. Reuse Graph.Map.wellFounded and controls_of_wellFounded plus the new actualSource_iff bridge; no ad hoc root criterion is introduced. Every world is a starter world and none has regress, yet no same existing source works in all worlds. Selected false is necessary and universally potentially causes each existing other, with a well-founded necessary-only union, but contingent true actually causes it at0. Thus the no-contingent-predecessor bridge cannot be omitted from the exact named-underived profile even after adding pointwise WF. Rank witnesses are not time; overlay edges never form an actual cross-world causal path. The prior frozen Bool control remains unchanged, and no metaphysical possibility or root closure is established.
